issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 01 requires the query to output ID, Name, Art and URL of all Freibäder (lines 108–109 in problem_statement.md). The reference solution (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql) selects only name, art, url and omits the ID column (lines 1–3). The template (template_repository/aufgabe01.sql) starts with SELECT * FROM Schwimmbad which would include an ID, but the provided solution does not. This mismatch (required column present in the specification but missing in the solution) will confuse students and can cause the automated column-check to fail or behave inconsistently.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the solution match the problem requirement by selecting the ID column as well (e.g. SELECT id, name, art, url FROM Schwimmbad WHERE art = 'Freibad'). Alternatively, if the ID column is intentionally excluded, update the problem statement to remove the ID from the required output to avoid confusion.
